Subject: RE: RevReseller addendum — proposed billing mapping & sample clause

Adding my take on billing flow. See inline below and attached sample clause (.docx).

Inline:
- Marketplace collects end-customer payment and remits to RevReseller. RevReseller invoices Redwood for the platform fee plus a marketplace pass-through line item. That pass-through line item is remitted onward to the marketplace.
- For Redwood accounting, we should treat pass-through amounts as reimbursables only when RevReseller: (a) provides supporting marketplace invoices and (b) we have a signed order form that includes the pass-through line.

Suggested contract language excerpt (high level):
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, pass-through marketplace fees shall be invoiced by the Reseller and paid by Redwood only upon receipt of Marketplace's invoice evidencing the fees. Reseller shall indemnify and hold harmless Redwood for amounts arising solely from Reseller's failure to collect or remit marketplace fees, except to the extent such amounts are directly caused by Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct."

Open items:
- VAT/GST treatment — Laura to confirm workflow.
- Timing: I can circulate a clean clause + tracked redline by 6/08 5pm PT.

Attachment: billing_pass_through_sample_clause.docx

-Ben
Head of Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: RevReseller addendum (MSA + OF) — integration checkpoints and next steps

Samantha — thanks for the draft and for the quick turnaround. Looping in our short answers and next actions below so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary decisions / asks:
- Pass-through billing: Redwood can accept a pass-through billing line provided (1) RevReseller furnishes marketplace invoices supporting the pass-through amounts and (2) the Order Form explicitly enumerates the pass-through line item. See Ben's sample clause (attached).
- Liability: Our legal team will propose a two-tier cap: 
   a) For amounts attributable to Redwood's service failures, standard cap applies.
   b) For pass-through marketplace fees, cap is limited and RevReseller must indemnify Redwood for third-party marketplace billing errors. Legal will send redline by 6/09.
- Audit window: We propose 60 days with limited-scope sampling tied to disputed invoices. Olga to send draft audit language by EOD 6/09.
- Invoicing cadence: We prefer monthly in arrears for platform fees; pass-through items can be billed monthly with supporting marketplace invoices.

Next steps / owners:
- Legal (Olga): redline for liability + audit clause by 6/09 (uploaded to Drive).
- Billing (Ben): clean pass-through clause + sample SAP/NetSuite mapping by 6/08 (done) — Ben attached clause.
- Sales Ops (Karthik): mutual action plan + HubSpot mapping by 6/11.
- RevReseller (Samantha): confirm whether marketplace requires advance collection or remits on 30-day terms.

Links & artifacts: Drive draft + redlines: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB23-example
HubSpot deal: HS-452391

If RevReseller can confirm the marketplace remittance timing today, we can finalize contract language on 6/09 and aim for signatures the week of 6/15.
